body.name: Causal Gaussian tent experiments
body.construction: For \(0<h\leq\min\{h_0,1/3\}\), choose \(3h\)-separated \(x_j\in B\), set \(\psi_{j,h}(z)=(1-\|z-x_j\|_2/h)_+\) and \(a_{\mathrm{tent}}=Lh/4\). Let \(Z_0,Z_1\) be independent standard Gaussians independent of \(X\), set \(T=\mathbf1\{R\geq0\}\) and \(Y=TY(1)+(1-T)Y(0)\). The baseline laws use the corresponding flat density and \(Y(t)=\sigma Z_t\); each tent law instead uses \(Y(1)=a_{\mathrm{tent}}\psi_{j,h}(X)+\sigma Z_1\) and \(Y(0)=-a_{\mathrm{tent}}\psi_{j,h}(X)+\sigma Z_0\).
